title: Luxuriously Charred Turkish Butter Beans Pilaf
description: A hearty and flavorful Turkish dish featuring charred butter beans, perfect for a hangover cure or a satisfying meal. This recipe combines Mediterranean-friendly ingredients with a double-fry method for crispy texture.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it starts to caramelize, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the soaked and drained butter beans, tomato paste, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the butter beans start to char.
Add the lemon juice and stir to combine, then continue cooking for another 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the butter beans are tender and charred.
Use a spatula to scrape the bottom of the pan and release any crispy bits.
Serve the pilaf hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or dill if desired.
To achieve the double-fry effect, remove the pilaf from the heat and let it cool slightly, then reheat it in the paella pan over high heat, stirring constantly, until crispy and golden brown.
